primary_predictive_score.variance_method: Taylor series with STRATUMID strata and HOUSEID primary sampling units

stochastic_stability.dependence_contract: The union bound controls familywise error without assuming independence between alternatives or seeds.
stochastic_stability.interval: For each seed and alternative, expected weighted share is sum(w_i*p_i)/sum(w_i). The simultaneous familywise 95% interval is expected share plus or minus 3.48075640434624*sqrt(sum(w_i^2*p_i*(1-p_i)))/sum(w_i).

tour_totals.variance_method: Taylor series with STRATUMID strata and HOUSEID primary sampling units

outcome_coverage.denominator: supported plus out-of-support mandatory patterns; incomplete diaries, no mandatory pattern, nonweekday records, and nonpositive weights are excluded

probability_scoring.candidate: Match ActivitySim 1.5.1 with sharrow disabled: cast every executable offset and learned coefficient to float32, promote the rounded values to float64 for the expression-value dot product, then compute shifted multinomial-logit probabilities in float64.
probability_scoring.predictor_invalid_rows: Use the frozen reference probabilities exactly.
probability_scoring.reference: Use the frozen unrounded status-cell probabilities in float64.

stochastic_stability.random_semantics: ActivitySim persons channel, mandatory_tour_frequency step, and choice_maker
stochastic_stability.row_order: stable NHTS person identifier order mapped to contiguous person_id

survey_estimator.degrees_of_freedom: sum over strata of PSU count minus one
survey_estimator.domain_method: Keep every positive-weekday-weight acceptance person in the survey design, including zero-contribution PSUs outside an analysis domain.
survey_estimator.stratum: Census division code crossed with NHTS STRATUMID
survey_estimator.variance: With-replacement Taylor linearization, no finite-population correction, and refusal of singleton strata.

tour_totals.division_rule: each measure independently must pass at least two divisions
tour_totals.interval: two-sided Taylor interval around the observed weighted mean

transfer_cells.alternative: candidate minus reference log loss is greater than zero
transfer_cells.family: all eligible pooled cells across all preregistered dimensions

limits: The only acceptance rule changed is simultaneous stochastic error control.
The implementation contract resolves previously unstated evaluator choices without changing a threshold, candidate, reference, population, or geography.
It does not use, summarize, or reveal acceptance outcomes.
The original preregistration remains the historical record.

reason.explanation: The original rule required 100 marginal 95% checks to pass. Even under independence, a correctly sampled model would pass all checks only about 0.6% of the time.
